question: When the generative writer aborts and the product falls back to the extractive answer, can the shipped code be made to say, in machine-readable fields on the bundle itself, that (a) the answer is degraded because the writer aborted, and (b) the independent adversarial counter-authority pass is DEGRADED/VACUOUS rather than 'measured and empty', so that an empty counter set can never be rendered as 'no contrary authority exists'?
why_this_is_the_ordered_item: Product cycle 39667945530 recorded a live slice whose generative writer failed (provider_error 'opencode CLI failed (rc=1): ') and whose answer was served through the extractive fallback with answer.status=degraded and answer.degradation ABSENT. The audit of product cycle 39815102517 ordered item 3: the abort must be a first-class degradation field, and the adversarial pass must inherit it. Product landed the field (product/answer_reliability.py::degradation_visibility tests it), but evaluation had not independently cross-checked the disclosure on the recorded degraded bytes. This is the smallest executable falsifier of the disclosure and the fastest v62 evaluation delta that does not require regenerated served bundles.
hypothesis: On the recorded pre-fix degraded bundle (CYCLE_39667945530_bundle.json, provider_error preserved verbatim), the shipped code at accepted product mount head fe219a19 satisfies four gates: (G1) pipeline._extractive_degraded_fallback stamps answer.degradation with code e_EMISSION_WRITER_ABORT, stage generative_writer, a non-empty disclosure that says an empty counter set is 'not measured' and never 'no contrary authority exists', and mirrors the record under provenance.generative_audit.degradation with emission_status WRITER_ABORT, while preserving all 151 decisions and not mutating its input; (G2) a subsequent adversarial_retrieval_pass in offline mode with max_new=0 inherits the abort, publishing degraded=true, degradation_code e_EMISSION_WRITER_ABORT and an adversarial_status containing WRITER_ABORT plus a measurement-gap disclosure, preserving every decision; (G3) the same pass on a derived bundle with empty answer prose takes the vacuous branch and publishes adversarial_status VACUOUS_WRITER_ABORT with skipped=true and the same inherited abort code; and (G4) the recorded healthy FIX1 bundle stays non-degraded after the same pass (adversarial_status MEASURED, no writer-abort code, answer.status ready), so the disclosure is not a blanket false positive. The product's own product/answer_reliability.py::degradation_visibility must agree with G1, G2 and G4.
baseline: the two recorded bundles at accepted product mount head fe219a19: CYCLE_39667945530_bundle.json (degraded writer, answer.status=degraded, answer.degradation=null, generative_audit.degraded=true, provider_error='RuntimeError: all provider attempts failed: opencode CLI failed (rc=1): ', 151 decisions) and CYCLE_39667945530_FIX1_bundle.json (healthy, answer.status=ready, answer.degradation=null, 158 decisions). The pre-fix absence of the field on the recorded degraded bundle is itself evidence of the defect and is recorded as context, NOT scored as a current failure: the current shipped code is what is executed.

gates.G1_abort_is_a_first_class_answer_field: the shipped extractive fallback on the recorded degraded bundle stamps answer.degradation.code == e_EMISSION_WRITER_ABORT, stage generative_writer, a disclosure containing both 'not measured' and 'contrary authority', mirrors it under provenance.generative_audit.degradation with emission_status == WRITER_ABORT and degraded == true, preserves the 151 input decisions, preserves the recorded provider_error verbatim, does not mutate the input bundle, and the product's own degradation_visibility() reports degraded=true and visible=true
gates.G2_adversarial_pass_inherits_the_abort: adversarial_retrieval_pass(offline, max_new=0, hydrate_top=0) on the G1 output publishes provenance.adversarial_retrieval.degraded == true, degradation_code == e_EMISSION_WRITER_ABORT, an adversarial_status containing WRITER_ABORT, a disclosure that names a measurement gap rather than an absence of contrary authority, preserves every decision, keeps answer.degradation present, and the product's degradation_visibility() reports visible=true
gates.G3_empty_prose_is_vacuous_not_measured: the same pass on a deep copy of the G1 output whose answer.prose is set to the empty string publishes skipped == true, skip_reason containing 'vacuous_pass', adversarial_status == VACUOUS_WRITER_ABORT, degraded == true, degradation_code == e_EMISSION_WRITER_ABORT, a non-empty disclosure, and preserves every decision
gates.G4_healthy_bundle_stays_non_degraded: the same pass on the recorded FIX1 bundle publishes degraded == false, degradation_code == null, adversarial_status == MEASURED, no writer-abort code anywhere in the pass record, answer.status == ready, answer.degradation absent/null, preserves every decision, and the product's degradation_visibility() reports degraded=false and visible=true

controls.C1_deleting_the_answer_field_fails_G1: removing answer.degradation from an in-memory copy of the G1 output must make the G1 predicate fail
controls.C2_relabelling_the_pass_as_measured_fail: setting degraded=false, degradation_code=null and adversarial_status=MEASURED on an in-memory copy of the G2 output must make the G2 predicate fail
controls.C3_injecting_an_abort_into_the_healthy_l: setting degraded=true, degradation_code=e_EMISSION_WRITER_ABORT and adversarial_status=DEGRADED_WRITER_ABORT on an in-memory copy of the G4 output must make the G4 predicate fail
controls.C4_network_guard_is_armed_and_unused: a guard that replaces socket.socket with a raising stub must itself raise when exercised, and the product calls must complete with zero guard attempts
controls.C5_product_and_input_pins_hold_before_an: the four product code files and both recorded bundles re-hash to their frozen pins before and after the calls, and the mount has no tracked-file modification

exit_code_contract.0: DEGRADATION_DISCLOSURE_VISIBLE - all four gates pass and all five controls hold
exit_code_contract.1: DEGRADATION_DISCLOSURE_GAP - at least one gate fails
exit_code_contract.2: ENVIRONMENT_OR_VACUOUS - missing mount/dependency/input, wrong run id, or a failed control; never a product verdict

population: exactly the two recorded bundle files named above, both already committed by the product lane and already present in the accepted product mount. No new retrieval, no new served bundle, no packet, no label and no geometry is produced.
claim_ceiling: This instrument establishes exactly one thing: on the recorded degraded and healthy bundles, the shipped code's writer-abort disclosure is visible, machine-readable, inherited by the adversarial pass, correctly vacuous when the answer has no legal vocabulary, and not raised on the healthy leg. It is NOT a retrieval-quality measurement, NOT a counter-authority recall measurement, NOT a re-score of any mapping-free or label gate, NOT a new served packet, NOT a live-answer reliability result, and NOT evidence that the product surfaces contrary authority. It does not meet, move or re-derive any frozen absolute bar; both bars stay REPORTED-ONLY and unmet on the v3 bytes; it lifts no DO-NOT-SERVE order; admission stays fail-closed; human_gate_ready, machine_gate_ready, packet_admitted, ready_for_owner_session and owner_decision_required stay false. It builds/re-scores no frontier candidate and runs no universal-174k benchmark. NOT_APPLICABLE and NOT_MEASURED are never a pass.
freeze_first_disclosure: An exploratory scratch probe of the same two shipped functions was run BEFORE this freeze in order to confirm the mount was importable and to learn the exact field names for the assertions; its output is not consumed as evidence and the frozen gates were not selected from it. The recorded degraded bundle's own pre-fix lack of answer.degradation was observed while diagnosing the product audit. The prediction (all four gates pass), the controls, the exit contract and the claim ceiling are fixed here BEFORE the claim-bearing execution on run 39820650174; no gate or threshold is changed after a result is seen. The product mount is read-only and is fingerprinted before and after.
network_policy: zero network. The adversarial pass is called with retrieval_mode='offline' and max_new=0; a socket guard is armed around every product call and any socket attempt is counted and reported (a non-zero count is a control failure).
determinism: deterministic code paths on fixed input bytes; no RNG, no model call, no retrieval, no threshold.
